name: FDS Website R4.2R Performance Evidence Manifest

benchmark_environment.statistical_method: 5-iteration median, mean, min, max; deltas computed from medians; <5% noise threshold
benchmark_environment.server_mode: embedded in-process HTTP static file server serving dist/

scenarios_covered: S1: Desktop Idle 1440px/3s (CDP Layout, RecalcStyle, Task, RAF frame tracking)
S2: Pointer Burst 1440px (5 bursts of 20 rapid pointermove events, CSS variable writes, recalc)
S3: Ecosystem Visible 1440px/3s (CDP Layout, RecalcStyle, Task, RAF frame tracking, animation states)
S4: Ecosystem Offscreen 1440px/3s (IntersectionObserver suspension, data-eco-paused, CDP metrics)
S5: Hidden Tab 1440px/3s (visibilitychange_logic_simulation: verifies application pause logic via simulated visibilitychange; not a physical browser-background CPU/battery benchmark)
S6: Reduced Motion 1440px/3s (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, animation state verification)
S7: Mobile Viewport 390px/3s (touch isolation, scene-wrap hidden, planet paused, CDP metrics)
S8: Kayla Copilot Open/Close 1440px (interaction-to-visible, CSS transition settle, close settle)
